name: Diego
personality: Untalkative and unsociable; happiest walking the forest, gathering medicinal herbs, or at Orchel's side.
story: A member of the Har Hali forest clan, descended from the Damascar Kingdom, Diego served as Orchel's guard during the Heroic Games and swore lifelong loyalty to them. He is 19-20 before the timeskip and 24 after. Recruiting him requires clearing Orchel's Paralogue.

personalSkill.name: Caretaker
personalSkill.effect: Adjacent allies cannot suffer a follow-up during combat. Trigger % = 5. Lv 20: No Mercy (+5 Hit/Crit on follow-ups); Lv 35: No Mercy+ (+10).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (support; Caretaker rated weak at 5%). Pocket Tactics: A tier. fortunesweave.co.uk rates Caretaker 1/5.

why: Support 2 here vs 3 on every other route.
Supports Theodora and Lilian in this army.
recruit.tip: Clear Orchel's Paralogue (10/18–10/24, Ch 12), then recruit him: about Lv 25 in a Specialty class. He sits the finale and Part II; he fights from Part III.

build.role: Part III sword skirmisher (no Part I or II deploy)
path: Rogue (Ch 12 join, about Lv 25; bench through Part II)
build.part1Target: Recruit only: joins in Ch 12 at about Lv 25 in a Specialty class; Rogue on join if he has Bow C and Sword C
build.notes: Ch 12 join (Orchel's Paralogue) for Part III only: he sits the finale and Part II (bench of the bench), so Army Training floors are his only Part II growth. Ranger in Part III S1, Shadow Seeker once Bow A and Sword A land, with a Cleansing Blade for the Underworld Boon.

guide.role: Part III sword skirmisher (no Part I or II deploy)
guide.summary: Part III only: a light sword doubler whose follow-ups get [[ability:No Mercy+]] (Hit/Crit +10). He joins in Ch 12 through Orchel's Paralogue, sits the finale and Part II, then fights from Part III. Lead with the sword and attack only where the forecast shows x2.
guide.playstyle: Sword first so he doesn't copy Lilian and Nuzzuo; the bow is for fliers and, as a [[class:Ranger]], [[ability:Countershot]]. Caretaker (adjacent allies can't be doubled, 5%) is a bonus, not a plan.
keys: Reach Support 2 with Theodora by 7/31: he joins only via Orchel's Paralogue (10/18–10/24).
Seat Theodora + Diego + Lilian at Sunday meals: one meal raises all three pairs.
Equip the [[item:Da Mina Sword]] +2 and [[item:Archer's Ring]] before Ch 12 ends: equipped gear carries.
Take [[class:Ranger]] in Part III S1 (Bow B, Sword B); Shadow Seeker at Lv 45.
Carry a [[item:Cleansing Blade]] in Part III: Wt 3, and it strips the Underworld Boon.
watch: Gate: Support 2 with Theodora before 10/16 and Renown 8 by Ch 12, or he can't join.

Weight: Part II Da Mina Sword +2 4 + Archer's Ring 3 = 7. Part III (no Soulstone) Iron Sword +4 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 6, Da Mina Bow +2 6 + 2 = 8, Cleansing Blade +2 3 + 2 = 5; AS = Spd + 3 − max(0, Wt − Bld). Ring off first if a double slips.
Res: 20 growth (25 as [[class:Rogue]]). Keep him off mage lanes; end turns behind Theodora.

Inventory: Part II 4 core (Da Mina Sword +2, Wooden Bow, Archer's Ring, [[item:Concoction]]). Part III 5 core (Iron Sword +4, Da Mina Bow +2, [[item:Cleansing Blade]] +2, Gale Ring, Concoction); Flyssa +2 in the open slot on armor maps.
